newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mbeki to pay official visit to India.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mbeki to pay official visit to India.

text.p: South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki will visit India next week to sign agreements on investment and double taxation, his office said on Friday.

The December 3 to 7 official visit coincides with the second meeting of the South Africa-India Joint Commission, focusing on political relations, defence, trade and technology, Mbeki's office said in a statement.
He would pay a courtesy visit to President Shankar Sharma and hold talks with the vice president, prime minister and the external affairs and finance ministers.

Mbeki, who will be accompanied by Trade Minister Alec Erwin and Mineral and Energy Affairs Minister Penuell Maduna, would sign agreements on avodance of double taxation, promotion and protection of investment and a memorandum of understanding on defence cooperation, the statement said.
South Africa and India are among several states advocating greater cooperation among Indian Ocean rim countries, particularly in the fields of tourism, technology, air transport, banking and finance.
